sources.title: North Micro Vision Instruct - docs.axolotl.ai
sources.snippet: North Micro Vision Instruct is a 2.4B-parameter open-weight vision-language model comprising a 2B language model and a custom-trained 400M native-resolution vision encoder. Its compact scale and broad image-understanding capabilities make it a practical foundation for task-specific customization.
